annotations.title: Best spots to work from this week (Camp Map Pass)

description: Camp Map Pass only (CA$55 a year or CA$5 a month). Ranks nearby spots by signal for the carrier, open sky for Starlink and flat ground, then adds each spot's 3-day forecast and marks workable days (under 2 mm rain, wind under 35 km/h).

carrier.description: Mobile carrier to rank signal for. Canada: telus (also Bell, Koodo, Virgin), rogers (also Fido), freedom, sasktel. US: verizon, att, tmobile, gci, inland. Defaults to telus in Canada and verizon in the US.

lng.description: Longitude in decimal degrees (WGS84), negative west of Greenwich.

radius_km.description: Search radius in kilometres (default 60, at most 200).

tz_offset_min.description: Minutes from UTC for day boundaries, e.g. -420 for Pacific daylight time. Default -420.
